title: For Thailand Market: Add TIS Certificate Mark on the Product Label as a Mandatory Qualification for 13 Categories
breadcrumb: For Thailand Market: Add TIS Certificate Mark on the Product Label as a Mandatory Qualification for 13 Categories
label: TIKTOK SHOP · CHANGELOG
subtitle: Updated 2026-07-04
html:
What is changing?

Starting from 5 August 2026, partners will be required to add TIS(Thai Industrial Standard) certificate mark on the product label as a mandatory qualification when listing or editing products by using API for 13 categories. This information will be put into the "certifications" parameter in the API. Here is the category list:

First_category_name Second_category_name Leaf_category_name Leaf_category_id
Household Appliances Home Appliances Irons 601100
Household Appliances Home Appliances Fans 601104
Household Appliances Home Appliances Air Cooler 880656
Household Appliances Home Appliances Electronic Mosquito Killers 934408
Household Appliances Home Appliances Air Purifiers 601090
Household Appliances Home Appliances Clothes Steamers 601107
Household Appliances Kitchen Appliances Microwave Ovens 848136
Household Appliances Large Home Appliances Refrigerators & Freezers 850312
Household Appliances Large Home Appliances Air Conditioner 849928
Household Appliances Large Home Appliances Washing Machines & Dryers 850184
Household Appliances Large Home Appliances Portable Air Conditioners 852496
Household Appliances Large Home Appliances Beverage Refrigerators 852624
Home Improvement Lights & Lighting Bulbs, Tubes & Strips 893704

Which markets are affected?

The updates of the requirements apply to cross border sellers in the Thailand market.

Who is affected?

Developers with applications that use Create Product, Edit Product, and Partial Edit Product

Which version is applicable?

The updates of the requirements apply to all versions of the related APIs

What action is required?

Without this mandatory qualification sellers will not be able to create or update products. Use the Get Category Rules API to check what certification requirements are mandatory for specific categories when using Create Product, Edit Product and Partial Edit Product API.
